descriptionMarkdown:
Train factory and lab recearch blueprint . I'm posting my book with sketches for the game Factorio with space exploration mod and krastorio 2 mod. Some of the prints need refinement .   Use 2 trains and 4 wagons.  The blueprint is for mid-game, or before of beginning of deep space exploration (production of  research packs). There are books inside from other authors that I took from reddit, and a good MALL for mid-game. Blueprint descriptions are written in Cyrillic, in the future... maybe.... maybe I will add new prints and correct old. Good luck!

I would be grateful if you could leave feedback if there is anything that needs to be corrected or added.

28.01.24 Added and fixed early game mall

29.06.23 The sulfuric acid production print was redesigned, all prints were sorted into separate folders to make it easier to find this or that print

22.06.23 Added new prints. Fix Nauvis space Mall. Added production green and blue modules.

21.06.23 Added new prints, added starter MALL Nauvis orbit basetube and HUB, added dash 2 material processing with industrial furnaces. Added production of productivity modules 1-3. Fixed some old prints.

18.06.23. Add new blueprints. Vulcanite processing train. Fixes some old blueprins.
